description: The image shows a top-down view of a small retail store. The store is organized into distinct areas: a display area with shelves occupying the majority of the floor space, a checkout or reception area with a counter and computer equipment, and a small area near the entrance possibly for waiting or displaying a specific item. Shelves line the walls and form aisles in the center of the room. A checkout counter is situated towards the front left of the store. Near the entrance, there is a round table with a plant, suggesting a welcoming or display element.
